✅ 1. backend/main.py
python
复制
编辑
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from routers import temu, blue

app = FastAPI()

# 允许跨域访问
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(temu.router, prefix="/api/temu")
app.include_router(blue.router, prefix="/api/blue")

@app.get("/")
def read_root():
    return {"message": "Temu Toolkit backend is running"}

✅ 4. backend/utils/scraper.py（模拟请求）
python
复制
编辑
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import os

TEMU_COOKIE = os.getenv("TEMU_COOKIE", "")
BLUE_COOKIE = os.getenv("BLUE_COOKIE", "")

headers = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0",
    "Cookie": TEMU_COOKIE
}

def search_temu(keyword: str):
    url = f"https://www.temu.com/api/search?q={keyword}"
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
    return response.json()

def search_blue(keyword: str):
    # 假设蓝站搜索为 GET 请求并返回 HTML
    url = f"https://www.blueimagesite.com/search?q={keyword}"
    headers["Cookie"] = BLUE_COOKIE
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, "html.parser")

    results = []
    for img in soup.select("img.search-result"):
        results.append({
            "src": img["src"],
            "alt": img.get("alt", "")
        })
    return results

jsx
复制
编辑
import { useState } from 'react';
import axios from 'axios';

function App() {
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState('');
  const [temuResults, setTemuResults] = useState([]);
  const [blueResults, setBlueResults] = useState([]);

  const search = async () => {
    const temu = await axios.get(`http://localhost:8000/api/temu/search?keyword=${keyword}`);
    const blue = await axios.get(`http://localhost:8000/api/blue/search?keyword=${keyword}`);
    setTemuResults(temu.data.items || []);
    setBlueResults(blue.data || []);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: 20 }}>
      <h1>TEMU Toolkit</h1>
      <input value={keyword} onChange={(e) => setKeyword(e.target.value)} />
      <button onClick={search}>搜索</button>

      <h2>🛒 TEMU 搜索结果</h2>
      <ul>
        {temuResults.map((item, idx) => (
          <li key={idx}>{item.title || item.name}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>

      <h2>🖼️ 图库搜索结果</h2>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
        {blueResults.map((img, idx) => (
          <img key={idx} src={img.src} alt={img.alt} width={120} style={{ margin: 5 }} />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;
